errors.evidence: The chart legend shows three algorithms (A-DBSCAN, Random, K-Center-Greedy), not four.
The vertical axis has no label in the figure.
The vertical axis range is from 0 to 100.
The tick marks on the vertical axis are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100).

errors.text_span: A-DBSCAN 的柱子为浅紫色，其高度约为 72。随机算法的柱子为橙色，其高度约为 74。K-Center-Greedy 算法的柱子间接为绿色，其高度约为 64。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns a single, generalized value to each of the three data series. Each series actually has five different values corresponding to the five categories on the x-axis. This over-simplification misrepresents the chart's data.

errors.text_span: Certificate 数据的柱子为黄色，其高度约为 68。Economy 数据的柱子为蓝色，其高度约为 68。Finance 数据的柱子为棕色，其高度约为 68。AVG 数据的柱子为灰色，其高度约为 70。
errors.evidence: The description fundamentally misunderstands the chart's structure by treating categories from the x-axis ('Certificate', 'Economy', etc.) as data series. These are categories under which the three algorithms are compared, not data series themselves with their own colors and values.
The phrasing '间接为绿色' (indirectly green) is awkward and unclear. A more direct description like '是绿色的' (is green) would be better.
